author: mostafa_gawad / JUMP ANIMATION
title: Hiring Vector Background Artists for animated series
content:
🎨 WE’RE HIRING! – VECTOR BACKGROUND ARTISTS

JUMP ANIMATION is looking for talented Vector Background Artists to join our upcoming animated series project!

Requirements:
* Strong skills in creating 2D vector backgrounds.
* Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator or Adobe Animate.
* Ability to match an established cartoon art style.
* Attention to detail and good artistic skills.

Project Duration: 2–3 Months (Freelance).

📩 Send your CV and Portfolio to:
* jobs@jumpanimation.com
* gawad26@gmail.com

💬 You can also message us directly through Facebook!

If you’re passionate about cartoon backgrounds and 2D animation, we’d love to hear from you!

author: whenthesilentbirdsings
title: Hiring Comic Artists, Writers & More for studio projects
content:
HIRING COMIC ARTISTS, WRITERS & MORE ⤵️

We’re looking for help with “When the Silent Bird Sings” and other studio projects.

These positions include:
Lineartist, sketch artist, colorist, storyboard artist, animators, music producers, language translators, comic writers/editors, personal assistants, video/reel editors/promoters, content creators & more.

These positions are paid but we’re open to collaboration / internships.

If you meet the requirements listed, then please send a *PROFESSIONAL* email to:
whenthesilentbirdsings@gmail.com

with the following information:
-Name, general location
-Position applying for
-Resume/Portfolio with previous & current experience & examples
-Rate per panel & for 60 panels (+/-)
-Rates for services/etc. (be open to negotiations if necessary)
-Turnaround Time for 60 panels/other work
-Programs / Software used (Clip Studio Paint, etc)

-Other notable experience / specializations

*NO DEADLINE, ROLLING APPLICATION ACCEPTANCE*

‼️ ABSOLUTELY NO AI USE IN THE PROCESS OR FINAL DELIVERABLES. ‼️

author: factornotes
title: Looking for Illustrator for stationery collections
content:
At Factor Notes, we love turning creative ideas into visuals that inspire, connect and tell a story.

We’re looking for a talented and detail-oriented Illustrator to join our team and create original artwork for our stationery collections and brand campaigns. If you have a passion for illustration, a distinctive creative approach and an eye for bringing concepts to life through visuals, we’d love to hear from you!

What You’ll Do:
Illustration & Artwork: Create original illustrations and artwork for our stationery, planners, product collections and brand campaigns.
Concept Development: Develop creative concepts, patterns, characters and visual elements that align with our brand identity.
Team Collaboration: Collaborate with the design, content and marketing teams to develop visuals that tell a cohesive brand story.
Creative Exploration: Experiment with illustration styles and contribute fresh ideas for product launches, seasonal collections and marketing campaigns.

Who You Are:
Experienced: Have 0–3 years of experience in illustration or a related creative field, supported by a strong portfolio of original work.
Technical Proficiency: Be proficient in digital illustration tools such as Adobe Illustrator and Procreate.
Creative Expertise: Have a strong understanding of colour theory, composition and visual storytelling, along with excellent attention to detail.

Interested in joining our team? Mail your resume and portfolio to: careers@factornotes.com
